rules.description: HTTPX2 is now the default HTTP client, and httpx is no longer installed automatically. Applications using custom HTTPX clients must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents.
rules.example_before: import httpx\nfrom openai import OpenAI\nclient = OpenAI(http_client=httpx.Client())
rules.example_after: import httpx2\nfrom openai import OpenAI\nclient = OpenAI(http_client=httpx2.Client())
rules.evidence: HTTPX2 is now the default HTTP client, and httpx is no longer installed automatically. Applications using custom HTTPX clients, transports, or configuration objects must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents or use the temporary, runtime-only legacy HTTPX escape hatch.
